messages:
maya: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up on the Token Service incident — RCA is posted: https://redwood.internal/rca/token-service-2026-03-19 (TL;DR: cascade from a config race during rolling deploy). I've pasted action items below; please claim ownership and add narrow deliverables. I'll be hosting a 30-min ops sync tomorrow to review progress :calendar:.

elena: Linking the RCA here too for folks who missed it — https://redwood.internal/rca/token-service-2026-03-19. Owners I called out: @elena (alerting), @michael (deploys), @tom (capacity). ETA suggestions?

tom: Question — what's the mitigation for the config race in the short term? Is there a flag we can flip?

elena: Short term: we have a roll-forward patch that disables parallel config apply. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482. Owner: elena. ETA: tomorrow EOD. Long term: serialization in the reconciler.

sam: From product perspective, will this change affect canary rollout flow / developer experience? Need to know before we ship next week's release.

michael: It will change deploy timing but not the API. I'll add clearer rollout docs and a slow-canary default. Action: michael -> document rollout steps and update console warnings. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ops-sync-1738123456.

maya: Please use the thread to claim items. I'll escalate any blockers. Action items I put in the RCA:
- A1: Add hard guardrails to alerting (owner: elena). Target: 2026-03-23.
- A2: Deploy reconciler serialization (owner: engineering-platform). Target: 2026-04-06.
- A3: Update rollback & canary docs (owner: michael). Target: 2026-03-25.
- A4: Retro & cross-team checklist (owner: tom + product). Target: 2026-03-22.

tom: Claiming A4. I'll loop in PM and set up the retro doc.

michael: Claiming A3. I'll drop a draft PR today.

elena: Claiming A1 and PR linked. Quick check command for oncall folks to verify alert config:
```
kubectl get configmap alert-config -n infra -o yaml | yq .data.token-service
```

incidents-bot: Created incident 2026-03-19-token-service-outage — RCA attached.

maya: Thanks all. One asked during Q&A about SLAs — short answer: no change to external SLAs; customers will be notified if needed. If you have follow-ups, add to thread and we'll cover tomorrow :eyes:.
